image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a black rectangular loudspeaker enclosure resting on a wooden surface. The speaker features a large central woofer with a metallic-looking cone and rubber surround, flanked by two smaller circular drivers (likely mid-range or tweeters) on the left side. There are visible mounting screws and a port opening at the bottom left. The finish appears to be matte black plastic or painted wood.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The reflection on the central dust cap and cone surface appears slightly overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the subtle micro-texture often seen in real paper or polypropylene cones, though this could also be due to lighting/flash photography.

artifact_observations.location: Screws on the right side of the large woofer
artifact_observations.reasoning: The screw heads appear slightly distorted and non-uniform. The slots in the screw heads do not align with standard Phillips or flathead geometry, appearing somewhat melted or generically shaped rather than mechanically precise.
